title: Retrospective analysis of the correlation between the preoperative assessment of liver-funcion via LiMAx and the occurence of complications during abdominal surgery, especially during operations of the pancreas.
summary: The aim of this study is to determine if by using an examination of liver-funcion prior to surgery a prediction can be made about the occurence of a specific and relevant complication after surgical removal of the head of the pancreas.

interventions.name: Retrospective anonymous analysis of the data of patients which underwent resections of the head of the pancreas between 2019 and 2024 in St. Bernhard Hospital in Kamp-Lintfort and who received a preoperative assessment of liver function via LiMAx as part of the preoperative diagnostics.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Pancreatic head resections
Exclusion criteria:
Total pancreatectomy
